How I Can Help

Whether you're struggling with anxiety, navigating a major life transition, or working through relationship challenges, I provide a warm, non-judgmental space for healing and growth.

Anxiety & Stress Management

Learn practical tools to manage anxiety, reduce stress, and develop coping strategies for life's challenges. Primary specialty for all ages.

Relationship Stress

Improve communication, resolve conflicts, and build healthier connections in all your relationships. Primary specialty for individuals, families, and couples.

Family Dynamics

Strengthen family bonds, improve communication, and resolve conflicts using systemic family therapy approaches.

Couples Therapy

Build stronger partnerships through improved communication, emotional connection, and conflict resolution using EFT approaches.

Teen & Preteen Support

Support young people (ages 10-18) through developmental challenges, identity formation, and emotional regulation.

Trauma-Focused Therapy

Heal from past experiences using specialized trauma-focused approaches in a safe, supportive therapeutic environment.

Life Transitions

Navigate major life changes with support and guidance through career shifts, relationship changes, and personal growth.

Christian Counseling

Integrate faith and spirituality into your healing journey when desired, honoring your beliefs and values.

Learn About My Services

My Approach

I believe therapy works best when it feels collaborative and authentic. Drawing from evidence-based approaches including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and Emotion-Focused Therapy, I tailor our sessions to your unique needs and goals.

Every person's journey is different, and I'm here to walk alongside you as you discover your own path to wellness and fulfillment.
